An extracted standalone checker constructed eight direct finite Fourier matrices (including GF(4)) and verified 3,642 exact sign cases. Computations are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first natural coordinate-character band on a Plücker Grassmann cone has an exact full condition-number and equality-space classification for every prime-power field and every ambient dimension at least four. The sharp threshold has three exceptional field-size regimes including characteristic two, and its proof needs a new strict determinant comparison; it is neither a known table lookup nor a minor numerical improvement. The classification supports quantitative harmonic sampling/conditioning studies on decomposable bivectors without asserting downstream results.
